limitations: The new limit gates warm reuse at job boundaries. It does not bound allocator growth during a job, RSS, direct runtime mappings or the full worker lifetime.
Allocator observations are process-wide and non-atomic. Unsupported or invalid observations retire the process after returning its completed result.

The retirement transport/reservation test uses a bound synthetic result rejected by the CPU verifier. The fresh full-size GPU run tests successful reuse below the ceiling, not forced over-ceiling GPU retirement.
Other caller/driver threads, cached thread storage, opaque/shared driver memory and overlapping worker/coordinator lifetimes still need enforced ownership bounds.
Ordinary workload admission remains closed for incomplete lifetime profiles.

All maintained proving families/routes, broader/live-cache workloads, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and newer Apple source integration remain open.
